context_files.purpose: Verbatim direction on extractability, dosage, bootstrap, parenting, and repetition.
Fourteen predecessor concerns and six missing tests.
Independent attack on estimands, active control, repetition, and target blindness.
Independent attack on writer, merge, lineage, dose, and isolation constructibility.
Exact V2 architecture proposal interpreted here.
Strict schema used to validate this interpretation.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal preserves the scientifically useful three-part architecture: THINK produces live child thought, action, and public outcome; DREAM only reconstructs bounded active context; SLEEP is an ordinary response-only post-training write over provenance-supported child experience. The bootstrap is a fourth experimental stage only in the developmental chronology, not a fourth cognitive organ: it is pre-life schooling whose merged effect is part of an immutable birth checkpoint. Static bootstrap process guidance may causally condition loss-bearing child responses even when its own tokens are masked, whereas live longitudinal parent prose may affect waking behavior but may not be ingested or targeted by personal SLEEP. The central hypothesis is feasible and testable, but these proposal bytes and their two-root canaries are not evidence that experience is extractable, that a birth is more teachable, or that parenting, repetition, SLEEP, or cadence works.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph repair is substantially more determinate than V1: one response-only writer, an exact zero-effective-delta initializer, a reference FP32 merge into two content-addressed BF16 births, fresh personal adapters on the assigned birth, and an atomic committed lineage distinguish schooling weights from personal memory. The paired direct-solution arm is correctly an active curriculum control rather than a semantic neutral: T versus D estimates feedback-computation schooling versus equally exposed direct-action practice, with M0 supplying a damage and pre-existing-competence diagnostic rather than a third randomized substitute. The three assay nodes must remain distinct. The standardized clone node can estimate immediate differential advice use. The fixed-policy node can estimate differential development under identical advice plus the frozen personal-SLEEP loop. The adaptive node can estimate only a joint adaptive-parent, child, experience-selection, compiler, gate, and SLEEP package interaction. None of those graph contrasts alone identifies a stable latent teachability trait or a uniquely weight-mediated pathway.
loop_delta_interpretation: The sequential loop order is scientifically appropriate: establish provenance/writer safety, build and freeze paired births without downstream information, test immediate standardized advice, then fixed-policy development, then the ecological adaptive package, and defer cadence until new authority. For Delta_R = [Y_T(correct)-Y_T(none)] - [Y_D(correct)-Y_D(none)], same-state disposable clones prevent practice, first-outcome, and lineage feedback from entering the immediate advice contrast; this identifies curriculum-relative selective advice responsiveness at birth if assignment, action scoring, and advice directions are frozen. For Delta_F = [AUC(T,fixed)-AUC(T,solo)] - [AUC(D,fixed)-AUC(D,solo)], byte-identical teaching prevents adaptive message quality from varying by birth, but active personal SLEEP means the estimand is the total interaction of birth curriculum with a fixed teaching-plus-SLEEP developmental regime, including treatment-induced child traces and ledgers; it is not a direct advice effect or a weight-only effect. For Delta_E = [AUC(T,parent)-AUC(T,solo)] - [AUC(D,parent)-AUC(D,solo)], root randomization, equal nonparent resources, and disposable exams can identify the selected adaptive parent-child-SLEEP package interaction; logged parent effort characterizes a component of that package but does not control it away. The repetition loop measures selective acquisition, fade, reset, relapse, and restoration. Without a separately randomized one-exposure versus spaced-repetition factor, it cannot identify a causal benefit of repetition itself.
claim_delta_interpretation: No scientific claim is presently identified because this is a proposal with no successor execution evidence. Prospectively, the retired V1 writer claim is correctly denied successor credit. C_EXPERIENCE_EXTRACTABLE_AND_USABLE is identifiable only after source reproduction, held-out-cue extraction, and fresh native action use receive disjoint splits, exact scores and practical margins, retrieval-free contexts, directional binding controls, preservation, and independently powered roots; lower source NLL and STATE_ONLY performance cannot establish recollection or use. C_BOOTSTRAP_IMMEDIATE_RECEPTIVITY is the best-identified bootstrap claim, but only as an incremental T-versus-D effect on immediate selective use of the same novel process advice; it is not lifetime learning, parenting acceleration, an absolute effect versus M0, or a general trait. C_BOOTSTRAP_FIXED_POLICY_LEARNING is defensible only if narrowed to faster entry-normalized development under the fixed advice-plus-personal-SLEEP regime relative to solo-plus-personal-SLEEP; identical advice does not make treatment-induced lived data, compiler views, or personal weights identical. C_BOOTSTRAP_ADAPTIVE_PACKAGE_ACCELERATION is correctly package-labeled and can support no parenting-alone, child-only, repetition-only, or SLEEP-mediation claim. C_SLEEP_CADENCE_TOTAL_PACKAGE is identifiable from randomized natural K4 versus K1 as a total package effect; standardized-ledger and natural-versus-standardized terminal contrasts remain conditional descriptive consequences, not a mediation decomposition. For every positive claim, two canary roots only license the next separately authorized study; at least six new root units and a frozen interval/multiplicity procedure are still necessary and not sufficient unless all construct and safety gates pass.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The intended firewall is scientifically sound: final hidden answers and scores are reporting-only outside the child/builder DAG; bootstrap construction precedes sealed downstream instances; static bootstrap conditioning is attended and response-loss-masked; personal grounded child traces alone may supply personal SLEEP; live parent text is visible during waking but absent from clean exams and forbidden from personal compilation. Two wording boundaries need exact resolution. First, the PARENT_TO_CHILD_TO_SLEEP edge calls parent prose response-loss-masked, which could imply that it remains attended by the personal writer, while the matrix says the SLEEP compiler never ingests it. Personal SLEEP should receive redacted/excluded child-native views with any raw parent bytes confined to an auditor-only provenance receipt; response masking is the rule for allowed static bootstrap conditioning, not permission to feed live parent prose to SLEEP. Second, final.public_observation is marked visible to SLEEP_COMPILER even though standardized, fixed-policy, adaptive, and final evaluation episodes must be disposable. The implementation packet must distinguish ordinary lived public observations eligible for later SLEEP from all evaluation observations, scores, transcripts, and clone outputs, which must be causally terminal.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V2_ES01_EXACT_AUTHORITY: all currently bound hashes can be checked, but this interpretation supplies no ratification, implementation, execution, or claim authority; any normative repair below requires new exact bytes and a fresh gate. V2_ES02_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_VIEW_IDENTITY: the five identities are correctly separated; the later packet must mechanize clause-level support, temporal availability, corrective evidence, duplicate occurrences, cross-life rejection, and validator disagreement without using later successful use as first-admission evidence. V2_ES03_EXACT_WRITER_ROUTE_MASK_AND_DOSE: match exogenous optimizer opportunity, encoded mask geometry, supervised-token counts, action locations, updates, configuration, initialization, and seeds; different treatments necessarily produce different response token identities, gradients, and Adam moments, so 'response tokens match exactly' can only mean counts/positions outside the declared differing spans. V2_ES04_ZERO_EFFECTIVE_DELTA_INITIALIZER: the A-nonzero/B-zero CPU fixture is the correct lowest-cost falsifier and must precede model execution. V2_ES05_BIRTH_MERGE_AND_CONTENT_IDENTITY: the reference merge, tensor inventory, immutable directory root, and parity tests make birth construction auditable, but all numeric tolerances must be frozen before inspecting real births and failure cannot license a post-hoc precision change. V2_ES06_LINEAGE_BINDING_AND_TRANSACTION_FAULTS: the complete store-by-store fault matrix and pre-import birth-root rejection are necessary; the previous adapter is a state comparator while the immutable birth is the weight parent, and only the committed closure may influence later data, briefs, context, or selection. V2_ES07_DIRECT_CONTROL_PAIR_AND_SEMANTIC_AUDIT: exact paired action/outcome and arm-independent admission remove cherry-picking, but the test validates a curriculum-package contrast, not semantic equivalence; the six-computation rubric must explicitly distinguish direct execution from self-generated 'stop and act' or 'retrieve and apply' behavior or its 0% D requirement is circular. V2_ES08_INCREMENTAL_TARGET_BLINDNESS: this can support only no incremental downstream-derived information in construction, not absence of knowledge already in M0/demonstrator or proof of conceptual unrelatedness; the auditor must return no final-derived value to the build DAG. V2_ES09_STANDARDIZED_ADVICE_RECEPTIVITY: with randomized disposable same-state clones and frozen mechanically scored Y, Delta_R identifies immediate selective differential advice use; irrelevant and wrong conditions are directional manipulation checks, and the claim remains relative to D rather than an absolute bootstrap-versus-M0 effect. V2_ES10_FIXED_POLICY_LEARNING: Delta_F identifies birth modification of development under identical fixed advice plus the active personal-SLEEP loop; it requires an exogenous message/repetition schedule that cannot fade in response to treatment-dependent child behavior, equal solo resources, clean parallel-fold exams, and an exact entry-normalization rule. V2_ES11_ADAPTIVE_PACKAGE_ACCELERATION: Delta_E identifies the selected adaptive package interaction if root assignment is randomized and exams are causally terminal; parent information/effort differences belong to the treatment and must not be described as controlled child receptivity. V2_ES12_REPETITION_ENACTMENT_FADE_AND_RELAPSE: the proposed behavioral state-machine test rejects phrase echo and measures selective uptake, but without repetition randomization it is not evidence that additional reminders caused learning. V2_ES13_STORAGE_EXTRACTION_USE_AND_CONTROLS: source reproduction, held-out extraction, fresh use, and preservation must remain separate, with exact disjoint split units, prompts, scores, margins, invalid handling, and per-control directional predictions frozen before generation; STATE_ONLY is deployment-surface supervision. V2_ES14_PERSONAL_UNREPLAYED_RETENTION: as written this is not a clean parametric-retention test under a topology that trains each replacement personal adapter fresh from the immutable birth; once the sentinel is removed from all later views, there is no direct sentinel-weight path into the replacement, and any survival may arise from later correlated or descendant experience. It needs relabeling or a separately ratified topology/ablation. V2_ES15_RANK_BY_EXPOSURE_ONLY: the grid can estimate compiler-conditional capacity by exposure and support an engineering selection only, not generic plasticity, age, or update strength. V2_ES16_CADENCE_TOTAL_AND_STANDARDIZED_LEDGER: random natural K4-K1 identifies the total cadence package; standardized-ledger and within-ledger natural-versus-standardized comparisons have only the proposed conditional labels and cannot sum to unique direct/indirect effects. V2_ES17_PRIMARY_STATISTICS_AND_SPEND_ORDER: exact ages, AUC transform, allocation, interval, multiplicity, safety estimand, and missingness rules remain to be frozen; the two-root same-direction margins are sequential canary gates only, while six new roots are the minimum independent replication units, not automatic claim sufficiency. V2_ES18_FRESH_REVIEW_AND_GPU_GATE: fresh implementation review, a non-overriding advocate, exact human GPU authority, and later claim-specific review remain mandatory; neither this interpretation nor eventual proposal ratification authorizes code, tokenizers, models, corpora, adapters, GPU use, publication, or claims.
assumptions: The symbols T and D denote immutable teachability-schooling and direct-solution-schooling births produced from the same M0, and all causal bootstrap statements are incremental T-versus-D contrasts unless M0 is explicitly named.
Curriculum roots, rather than tasks, ages, advice items, rows, or training seeds, are the independent assignment and inference units.
The later implementation packet will randomize or otherwise prospectively assign advice/solo and parent/solo treatments within independently generated roots before any outcome is observed.
Disposable assay and examination clones cannot write, alter a parent, affect selection, enter a ledger, or change the continuing lineage.
Entry-normalized AUC will be a prospectively fixed transform applied identically to all arms, with all raw entry scores and curves retained.
The fixed-policy assay intends personal SLEEP to be part of the developmental treatment response, while the standardized-advice assay intentionally excludes it.

The active direct-solution control is expected to differ irreducibly from teachability schooling in conditional information and cognitive work; pairing and calibration bound nuisance imbalance but do not erase that semantic difference.

The six-new-root rule is only a minimum replication count; a scientific claim also requires a prospectively fixed uncertainty and multiplicity procedure plus all construct, nonleakage, and safety gates.

ambiguities.question: Is Y for Delta_R binary task success, successful strategy-dependent action, a joint action-and-outcome indicator, or a prespecified vector with one primary component?
ambiguities.impact: The resolution and V2_ES09 use slightly different descriptions; wrong advice can redirect strategy without changing task success, so the selected endpoint changes both the estimand and its directional falsifiers.

ambiguities.question: What exact formula converts raw longitudinal scores into entry-normalized AUC, at which frozen ages and horizon, and is baseline subtraction, headroom scaling, or covariate adjustment intended?
ambiguities.impact: Different transforms answer different questions and can behave differently when T and D have unequal entry scores; leaving the choice open prevents Delta_F and Delta_E from being claim-ready.

ambiguities.question: What is the exact treatment-allocation, pairing, blocking, rerun, and root-level interval procedure for the four-arm fixed and adaptive assays?
ambiguities.impact: Matched tasks and seeds do not by themselves establish random assignment, and six roots without a frozen analysis procedure do not identify uncertainty or multiplicity control.

ambiguities.question: What exact no-advice activity matches parent turns, attended tokens, context displacement, latency, and resource opportunity in fixed-policy and adaptive solo cells without becoming another teaching treatment?
ambiguities.impact: A passive solo condition can make the teaching contrast partly a compute, context, or experience-opportunity contrast; an active sham can itself change learning.

ambiguities.question: How do the semantic rubrics distinguish direct execution of a supplied action from computation 3 ('stop recursion and act') and distinguish following supplied advice from computation 6 ('retrieve and apply a prior correction')?
ambiguities.impact: Without operational exclusions, the required 0% direct-control computation prevalence may be impossible or may be achieved only by defining treatment membership into the rubric.

ambiguities.question: Which exact compiler factors, cue families, identity splits, practical margins, and aggregation rules constitute the 'dose-matched writer factorial' required by C_EXPERIENCE_EXTRACTABLE_AND_USABLE?
ambiguities.impact: V2_ES13 names outcomes and controls but the proposal does not fully specify the randomized writer treatment whose effect would support the headline-eligible experiential-memory claim.

ambiguities.question: For each use of the -0.05 adverse bound, what comparator, aggregation unit, one- or two-sided interval rule, and terminated-lineage handling apply?
ambiguities.impact: D-versus-M0 birth damage, candidate-versus-previous preservation, and developmental package harm are different safety estimands and cannot share an undefined point-estimate rule.

ambiguities.question: Which public observations are ordinary lived evidence eligible for later SLEEP, and which belong to disposable development/final evaluations that must never enter SLEEP despite the broad final.public_observation visibility cell?
ambiguities.impact: Failing to type this distinction permits exam feedback or final evaluation experience to contaminate later weights and invalidate every learning and transfer claim.

ambiguities.question: What preregistered threshold or adjudication rule converts the structural-overlap table into pass/fail, especially for partial overlap in hidden-state inference, feedback timing, or solution algorithms?
ambiguities.impact: A reviewer-only qualitative rejection rule can drift after seeing the curricula and does not by itself distinguish intended general transfer from downstream-policy rehearsal.

ambiguities.question: What frozen quantitative condition makes D 'grossly' easier or otherwise triggers the orthogonal workload control or proposal failure?
ambiguities.impact: M0 calibration is diagnostic but, without a threshold fixed before corpus construction, difficulty handling can become outcome-informed control tuning.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: V2_ES14 should not be called personal unreplayed parametric retention under the proposed fresh-from-birth replacement-writer topology.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Every personal candidate starts at zero effective delta on the immutable birth rather than inheriting the previous personal adapter. If a sentinel is absent from all later compiler views, its trained parameter contribution is absent from the replacement adapter by construction. Residual behavior could reflect generalized or descendant later data, not retention of the earlier personal write.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Either relabel V2_ES14 as survival under cumulative-ledger recompilation and explicitly audit every descendant/correlated support path, probe retention before replacement, or propose and separately ratify a weight-continuous topology or counterfactual ablation. Do not claim unreplayed personal-weight retention from the current test.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The fixed policy's prohibition on inspecting child behavior conflicts with applying the common acquisition-triggered fade and relapse loop to that assay.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: If message timing changes when the child satisfies or loses an uptake criterion, the policy has consumed treatment-dependent behavior and advice bytes/timing are no longer identical across births. If it never inspects behavior, it cannot enact acquisition-triggered fade.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use one exogenous preregistered reminder/fade schedule in all fixed-policy lineages and score acquisition/relapse only as outcomes. Reserve behavior-triggered fade/restoration for the adaptive package and label it part of that package.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The PARENT_TO_CHILD_TO_SLEEP edge should not describe live parent prose as response-loss-masked if the visibility contract forbids the SLEEP compiler from ingesting it.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Loss masking still makes attended parent tokens causal conditioning for response prediction. That is appropriate for frozen bootstrap guidance but violates the stronger personal-SLEEP rule that longitudinal parent prose is not an input or target.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: State separately that live parent text is attended only during waking, then redacted or excluded from all personal compiler views with audit-only provenance linkage; only allowed static bootstrap conditioning is attended and response-loss-masked by the birth writer.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: C_BOOTSTRAP_FIXED_POLICY_LEARNING is too easily read as isolating learning from teaching alone.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Although advice bytes are fixed, the active SLEEP loop writes treatment-induced child traces, lessons, views, gates, and weights. Delta_F therefore includes the interaction of schooling with the entire fixed-curriculum-plus-SLEEP developmental regime.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rename or explicitly qualify the claim as fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP learning acceleration and forbid advice-only, child-intrinsic, or weight-mediation language.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: V2_ES03's expectation that 'response tokens ... match exactly' cannot literally hold for curricula whose named computation spans are supposed to differ.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: T and D require different loss-bearing response content, hence different token IDs and realized gradients. The valid nuisance-control requirement is exact supervised-token count, response/action position, mask geometry, batch/update opportunity, and configuration outside declared treatment spans.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Replace the phrase with 'supervised response-token counts and positions match exactly; token identities may differ only in declared treatment spans' and continue to prohibit claims of identical realized Adam paths.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Unqualified 'task-blind birth' or 'without importing final-task experience' language should not imply that M0 or the demonstrator lacks pre-existing final-family knowledge.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The temporal/ACL/mutation design can exclude new final-derived information from bootstrap construction, but it cannot erase knowledge already present in pretrained weights or prove conceptual independence merely from source nondependence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use only 'no incremental downstream-derived information entered bootstrap construction,' retain M0/D/T sealed-task diagnostics, and report structural overlap as a bounded transfer audit rather than a universal blindness certificate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The required-before-scientific-claim labels on V2_ES09 through V2_ES11 must not be read as making their two-root pass conditions sufficient for those claims.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: V2_ES17 says the canaries only license sequential spending and requires at least six new independent roots plus a later frozen analysis. Without this joint reading, the artifact contains an apparent two-root claim gate that contradicts its own inference boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Make the dependency explicit in any consensus or implementation packet: V2_ES09, V2_ES10, and V2_ES11 canary passes are feasibility evidence only; scientific claims require their separately frozen six-new-root replications, exact intervals/multiplicity, and renewed human claim authority.

open_questions: Does Rohin accept the narrow identification labels: Delta_R is immediate T-versus-D selective advice responsiveness, Delta_F is a fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP developmental interaction, and Delta_E is the adaptive parent-child-SLEEP package interaction?
Will the exact successor consensus resolve whether V2_ES14 is relabeled or replaced, given that fresh-from-birth personal adapters do not carry an omitted sentinel's prior parameter update?
Will fixed-policy repetition use an exogenous identical schedule while behavior-triggered fade and relapse remain part of the separately labeled adaptive package?
Will the parent-text contract explicitly exclude/redact live parent bytes from personal SLEEP inputs, while retaining response-masked attended conditioning only for the separate static bootstrap?

Before generation or model execution, what exact Delta_R outcome, AUC normalization, ages, allocation, safety estimands, writer-assay margins, structural-overlap rule, and root-level interval/multiplicity procedure will be frozen?

Does Rohin ratify only the exact proposal after fresh critique and consensus, while continuing to forbid implementation, tokenizer/model execution, corpus generation, adapter work, GPU use, resource acquisition, publication, and scientific claims until their later exact gates?
